Paul Evans led all the way in the 5k to be caught on the line by Steve Harris. The pole vault proved to be controversial with the leading vaulters opting out, because of a dangerous take off box.
If new member Steve Harris, who placed 5th, had been eligible for the race (we believe he will be for the next) we would have won the match.

Apart from Staines' performance there were good Belgrave supporting roles from Steve Harris, making his debut in Belgrave colours in 5th place but unable to score, and Frank Ward back to his best form in 8th.

Conditions were fairly still but the air temperature was dropping as at five minutes to 9pm the Belgravian set out on his 25 lap trial with just Colin Reitz, Andy Bristow and Steve Harris for company.
